MONGODB_VERSION.description: Specific version of mongodb to install. Can be a numeric version or an alias.

MONGODB_INSTALL_METHOD.description: How to install MONGODB. 'libscript-native' uses isolated version dirs, 'system' uses OS package manager, 'mise' or 'asdf' defers to third-party tools.

LIBSCRIPT_LISTEN_SOCKET.description: Global unix socket to listen on

MONGODB_LISTEN_PORT.description: Port for MONGODB to listen on

MONGODB_LISTEN_ADDRESS.description: Address for MONGODB to listen on

MONGODB_LISTEN_SOCKET.description: Unix socket for MONGODB to listen on

MONGODB_SERVICE_RUN_AS_USER.description: Windows local user account to run the service (leave empty for Network Service)

MONGODB_SERVICE_RUN_AS_PASSWORD.description: Password for the local user account (if applicable)

MONGODB_SERVICE_NAME.description: Custom name for the Windows Service (allows side-by-side installations)
